dev.//: Astro's dev server over the vault, content/public. The vault is read again whenever a file in it changes, so a new or renamed note's links follow without a restart.

build.//: Build the vault into astro/dist, once `check` passes: astro build strips types without checking them. The vault is an input, so a changed note rebuilds.

test.//: The unit tests of the pure modules under src/lib, on Vitest, over the fixture vault (test/fixtures/vault). One file: `nx run astro:test -- test/notes.test.ts`.

mirrors.//: Saves a mirror of each annotated document that has none into the vault's mirror directory, assets/annotated-documents, which git ignores (docs/adr/2801). A saved mirror is pinned and never fetched again; delete it to fetch it afresh. The only target that reaches the network for the vault: run it before a build that should have every mirror, as the deploy does. A document that can't be fetched is reported, and its page is built with its annotations alone.

e2e.//: The Playwright specs against the built site: over the fixture vault (src/test/fixture), or with the `vault` configuration over the real one (src/test/vault). The suite builds its own site into .e2e and serves it on a port of its own, which E2E_PORT overrides (docs/adr/0007). One spec: `nx run astro:e2e -- notes`. Never beside another build in the same checkout, and never beside its dev server, which the suite refuses to start next to: every build writes the same .astro directory, and the dev server reads it. Stop the dev server first, or run the suite from another worktree.
